exposure: Type of visit (ED visit or hospitalization)
outcome: Risk of early term birth (37 to 38 weeks)
cohort: Women giving birth in California between 2011 and 2017
finding: Women with a UTI during pregnancy were at elevated risk of birth <32 weeks, 32 to 36 weeks, and 37 to 38 weeks, regardless of trimester, type of PTB, and antibiotic treatment.
